{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v1, a field annotated Optional[X] without a value implicitly defaulted to None. In Pydantic v2 such fields are required. Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior for bio, website, and age. This also fixes test_blank_fields_become_none, because profile_from_form drops blank/None form values, so these keys are now absent and would otherwise fail validation as missing."}], "notes": "One edit covers lines 8-10 (the three Optional fields), which are adjacent and non-overlapping. The test-failure finding (app/profiles.py:15) is resolved by the same change, since the missing-field error comes from the same v2 required-Optional behavior; no change to profile_from_form is needed. No deprecated v1 APIs appear in this file, so no import changes are needed: Optional and BaseModel remain in use. interests: List[str] = [] already has a default and is left unchanged. The migration docs were not retrieved, so the explanation relies on the documented v1-to-v2 change in Optional default handling."}
